Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you please
state your full name for the record?
A: Sure. I'd rather not put my full name on it, so just call me the claimant.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was on a two-lane road in Conroe, Texas, near a shopping center. I was heading toward the intersection when
the other car came into my lane.
Q: How fast were you traveling when the vheicles made contact?
A: Not fast at all. I'd guess maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour. I was slowing down for traffic, and the other driver
seemed to be drifting over.
Q: Were there any airbags deployed in your vehicle?
A: No, nothing deployed. Both cars were drivable, and we pulled over to the shoulder.
Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same afternoon. My neck was sore and stiff, and I had a headache that got worse
overnight.
Q: What did the provider tell you?
A: They said I had a neck strain and gave me muscle relaxers and some instructions for stretching. They also
recommended I follow up with my own doctor.
Q: Have you had any piror neck problems or injuries to that area?
A: Nothing serious. I had a little stiffness now and then from sitting at a desk, but nothing that stopped me from
working.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?
A: Some days are better than others. Turning my head to the left is the hardest part, and I still get tired of sitting in
one position for long.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I want to cooperate fully and get this resolved. I appreciate your patience.
Q: Thank you for your time today. We'll be in touch with next steps.
</page>
